profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at BAE Systems
profile.summary: Experienced Senior Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the Business Supplies & Equipment industry. Skilled in Python (Programming Language), C++, Core Java, Java, and JavaScript. Strong engineering professional with a Master of Science - MS focused in Computer Science from Georgia Southern University.
